notes:
New: a Saxophone stem. Turn it on when you split a song, or right-click a split song and choose Pull Out the Saxophone. When a song has no singer, the sheet music writes the sax as the melody.
New: Split the Drums. Right-click a split song to turn its Drums into Kick, Snare, Toms, Hi-hat and Cymbals tracks, and Put the Drums Back Together any time.
Fixed: very long recordings (like hour-long compilations) no longer run out of memory. Jsolator now works through them in pieces, and tells you up front if one is too long for this Mac.
